How We Work

Our Delivery Process

Four stages, each with a defined output you sign off before we move on.

01

Consult

We walk the site, review your drawings and understand the constraints before quoting anything.

02

Plan & Price

Itemised bill of quantities, method statement and a programme with real milestone dates.

03

Build

Directly supervised execution with weekly progress reporting and stage-wise quality sign-off.

04

Hand Over

Snagging closed out, as-built drawings issued, O&M manuals delivered, defects period supported.

Why Choose Us

What You Actually Get

Own Workforce

Honest Programme

After Handover

Defect liability support and optional annual maintenance contracts.

Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

The things clients ask before signing a construction contract.

Do you handle approvals and drawings?

On turnkey contracts, yes - structural design, MEP coordination and the municipal approval trail are included. On structure-only contracts we build to the consultant's drawings and coordinate with their team.

Ready To Break Ground?

Send us your drawings, a scope note, or just a rough idea. We will come back with a realistic programme and an itemised budget.
